ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Social Services
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of federal funds in social services programs and identify potential areas of fraud
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records review
questions: What programs are most vulnerable to fraud?
How can we identify and prevent fraud in these programs?
ideas.insight: By analyzing data and public records, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that could indicate fraudulent activity. This investigation could lead to a deeper understanding of the scope of social services fraud and inform strategies for prevention and detection.
